title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan

thread.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan • FX Senshi Kurumi-chan - Episode 2 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the protagonist entertainingly reckless and compared her favorably to characters from gambling-themed series.
The thread shows strong engagement with the episode’s gambling premise and its comedic exaggeration.
Commenters enjoyed the character’s extreme risk-taking but also framed it as irresponsible, self-destructive, or lacking self-preservation.
Some reactions judged the protagonist’s behavior as excessively reckless and morally troubling.

notes: The title and post body explicitly identify FX Senshi Kurumi-chan, episode 2. I read 10 visible substantive comments/replies from this thread only; Reddit exposed 238 total comments, many of which were not individually retrieved. Summaries are paraphrased and spoiler-free.
